title: linaria aegyptiaca subsp. fruticosa
intro: Linaria aegyptiaca subsp. fruticosa, commonly known as Egyptian toadflax, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. Egyptian toadflax is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of the plant's therapeutic potential and to confirm its traditional uses in folk medicine.
